# Trauma Informed Oregon

> A comprehensive resource hub providing trauma-informed care training, frameworks, and support for Oregon organizations and professionals.

Trauma Informed Oregon (TIO) is a statewide collaborative effort to advance trauma-informed care practices across Oregon. The organization, in partnership with Portland State University and the Oregon Health Authority, offers free and accessible training modules, resources, and consultation services to help professionals and organizations implement evidence-based trauma-informed approaches.

## Key Topics

- Trauma Informed Care (TIC)
- Adverse Childhood Experiences (ACEs)
- Professional Development
- Training Modules
- Neurobiology
- Organizational Implementation
- Workforce Wellness
- Mental Health Support
- Community Response
- Embodiment Practices
- SAMHSA Framework
- Oregon Health Authority
- Certification
- Online Learning Resources
- Trauma-Informed Principles

## Core Training Programs

- [TIO Courses and Trainings](https://traumainformedoregon.org/resources/training/tio-courses-and-trainings): Overview of TIO courses and training offerings for professional development.
- [Intro to Trauma Informed Care Training Modules](https://traumainformedoregon.org/resources/training/tic-intro-training-modules): Free self-directed introductory modules covering TIC basics and neurobiology.
- [Foundations of TIC Modules](https://traumainformedoregon.org/foundations-of-tic-modules): Eight-video course on foundational TIC topics and organizational culture.
- [Foundations of Trauma Informed Care Videos](https://traumainformedoregon.org/resources/training/foundations-of-tic-videos): Video training on TIC foundations with workbook and neurobiology content.
- [Core Training Components for Trauma Informed Care](https://traumainformedoregon.org/resources/training/core-training-curriculum): Guide to foundational knowledge and learning objectives for TIC training.
- [How to Choose a Trainer](https://traumainformedoregon.org/resources/training/how-to-choose-a-trainer): Interview guide and selection criteria for choosing TIC trainers.

## Foundational Knowledge

- [What Is Trauma Informed Care?](https://traumainformedoregon.org/resources/new-to-trauma-informed-care/what-is-trauma-informed-care): Definition and principles of TIC, distinguishing from trauma-specific services.
- [Trauma Informed Care Principles](https://traumainformedoregon.org/resources/new-to-trauma-informed-care/trauma-informed-care-principles): Core TIC principles focused on safety, trustworthiness, and empowerment.
- [What is Trauma?](https://traumainformedoregon.org/resources/new-to-trauma-informed-care/what-is-trauma): Beginner guide defining trauma types and emotional distress responses.
- [Adverse Childhood Experiences (ACE) Study and Trauma](https://traumainformedoregon.org/resources/new-to-trauma-informed-care/adverse-childhood-experiences-ace-study): Explanation of ACE Study and its impact on adult physical and mental health.

## Resources & Implementation

- [Trauma Informed Care Resource Library](https://traumainformedoregon.org/resources/trauma-informed-care-resource-library): Comprehensive resource library for TIC tools and materials for providers.
- [Embodiment Practices for TIC](https://traumainformedoregon.org/embodiment-practices-for-tic): Somatic therapy and grounding techniques for stress regulation and healing.
- [Community Response to Tragedy](https://traumainformedoregon.org/resources/community-response-to-tragedy): Trauma-informed resources and support centers for responding to tragic events.
- [Community Incident Response - COVID-19 Workforce Wellness](https://traumainformedoregon.org/resources/community-incident-response): COVID-19 workforce wellness resources and resilience strategies for TIC.

## About & Support

- [About Trauma Informed Oregon](https://traumainformedoregon.org/about): Organization overview and mission of statewide trauma-informed care collaborative.
- [Staff and Partners](https://traumainformedoregon.org/about/staff): Leadership team and community partners directory for TIO.
- [FAQs](https://traumainformedoregon.org/about/faqs): Common questions about TIO, training, consultation, and services.
- [Contact Trauma Informed Oregon](https://traumainformedoregon.org/about/contact): Contact form and inquiry information for Trauma Informed Oregon.
